# Paula Huffman — Yoga, Mindfulness & Integrative Practice

> Paula Huffman, BS, RN, E-RYT, Mindfulness Instructor, teaches yoga, mindfulness, and MBSR (Mindfulness-Based Stress Reduction) courses via live Zoom and in-person in North Carolina, backed by 40+ years of teaching and clinical experience, including 16 years on faculty at UNC Chapel Hill's Program on Integrative Medicine.

Offerings include MBSR courses, mindfulness workshops, a brain health course, restorative yoga classes, and multi-day retreats. Classes run live via Zoom and in-person at several North Carolina locations. All events are led by Paula Huffman unless otherwise indicated.
